paragraphs: He is mentioned in Kiddushin 39b, posing a contradiction to Rava; Hyman suggests that perhaps the reading should be “to Rav.”[^1]

notes.text: The named William Davidson Kiddushin 39b paragraph gives Rav Tuvi bar Rav Kisna posing the contradiction to Rava. Hyman’s alternative “to Rav” remains his tentative proposal, not an adopted correction or new chronological identity. Both explicit Rav titles in the heading are retained; no other figures or legal material from the paragraph are imported.
